verdict.rationale: gstack ships its own mechanisms for agents to create skills. The /skillify meta-skill codifies a /scrape flow into a reusable script, and domain-skills let an agent save per-site skill notes and promote them from per-project to global. Both are narrow and domain-specific rather than a general end-to-end spec for authoring and packaging arbitrary new skills; the dev-mode symlink is a contributor convenience, not an authoring template. Missing for 10: a general skill-authoring spec or template, a documented end-to-end packaging and distribution flow for arbitrary skills, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill

citations.quote: Future /scrape calls with the same intent run the codified script in ~200ms instead of re-driving the page.
